## Change

Describe the behavior and compatibility impact.

## Security review

- [ ] Authorization invariants and trust boundaries are unchanged or documented.
- [ ] Deny, missing-data, malformed-input, and extension-failure paths are tested.
- [ ] Resource limits, sensitive diagnostics, and audit behavior were considered.
- [ ] Serialization/schema/migration and supply-chain impact were considered.
- [ ] Threat model, assurance evidence, and release notes are updated if needed.

## Verification

List exact commands and results. Identify any skipped check and why.
